absent: Pool, work, worker, and workqueue full layouts beyond touched fields, including color count value and dependency checking, are absent.
Barrier work behavior, work flag meanings, and inactive versus pending versus in flight lifecycle rules are absent.
Parallel data layout, cpumask setup and start helpers, global free work pool management, and hotplug callbacks are absent.
Kernel parameter operations, module structure, lockdown and taint semantics, and unknown handler contract are absent.
Sysfs group layout, device lifetime rules, and deferred console plus watchdog guarantees are absent.

findings.text: A blocking drain for a workqueue waits until every item submitted before the call has finished, using per caller color tracking and completion with leader driven cascade to later waiters.
A per workqueue diagnostic prints pool queue state only when at least one pool queue holds activity, otherwise producing no output for idle queues.
Instance creation builds parallel and serial helpers plus CPU affinity state from a name and returns null on any failure, while release drops a reference on the embedded object to trigger freeing.
Shell creation attaches a new shell and its parallel data to an instance under protection, and shell release detaches and drops references while safely ignoring a null shell.
Argument scanning turns a free text buffer into successive name and value pairs with space skipping and a bare terminator, and name matching treats dash and underscore as interchangeable.
An unsigned integer setter validates presence and numeric form of input and enforces a caller supplied inclusive minimum and maximum before storing the result.
A definition family creates a matched setter and getter plus an operations descriptor for a scalar parameter type and publishes all three symbols.
Pool queue emptiness holds exactly when the active count is zero and the inactive list is empty.
Color succession moves forward by one modulo the configured color count, forming a fixed size ring.
A pool queue is busy when any color flight count is nonzero, when a non default queue retains extra references, or when emptiness does not hold.

Preparation marks only pool queues with outstanding flights in the requested color, tallies participants including the leader, advances work color when asked, and completes the leader at once when nothing needs waiting.
Instance sysfs handlers recover the containing instance and entry from generic objects and invoke the entry callback only when present, otherwise reporting an input output error.

Mask show and store choose between serial and parallel state by attribute name, with show formatting the chosen mask as text and store parsing text into a scratch mask before applying it with a type selector.
Default attributes for an instance are exactly the serial and parallel mask entries followed by a null terminator.
The instance object type binds generic show and store dispatch with default groups and a release action that frees the whole instance.
Single parameter lookup enforces level bounds, rejects absent values unless argument free use is declared, and delegates unknown names to a caller handler when available.
Hardware tagged parameters are refused while module parameter lockdown is active, and parameters marked unsafe cause a notice plus kernel taint while still allowing the update.
Parameter value allocations are recorded on a global list at creation and removed and freed only when the exact value pointer is later presented.
Diagnostic work listing collapses repeats of one function into a counted form and shows barrier entries by owning task identity instead of a symbol.
Pool reporting covers affinity, optional node, flags, and priority with distinct forms for bottom half versus normal pools, and worker reporting adds rescue marking.

Workqueue mutex guards color fields and waiter queues across assignment and cascade but is released during sleep, while pool interrupt safe spinning guards per pool color changes and is held across consecutive queues sharing one pool.
Per pool diagnostic checks hold the pool interrupt safe lock while testing emptiness and reporting, using deferred console handling to avoid reentry from paths that queue work.
Instance mutex protects mask reads and shell list changes, and CPU read protection spans helper creation, mask setup and startup as well as shell data allocation.

Parameter mutation runs under a global mutex or the owning module mutex with a build variant that always uses the global one, while a dedicated spin lock guards the tracked allocation list and a check variant either asserts lock held or does nothing.
A flush waiter combines a queue link with a requested color starting as absent and a completion used for sleep and wakeup.
A sysfs entry embeds a generic attribute and stores optional show and store callbacks that consume an instance with attribute and text buffer.
A tracked allocation node links into a global list and provides trailing bytes that serve as the visible value storage.
Coalescing state for diagnostics keeps a repeat count with pending function and separator memory to merge adjacent identical symbols.
An instance aggregates parallel and serial helpers, parallel and serial plus validation affinity state, a shell list, an embedded lifetime object, a mutex, and hotplug linkage.

Drain moves through assignment then sleep then cascade where the leader wakes same color peers, advances the finished marker, folds overflow waiters into the main queue, and promotes the next leader until no waiter remains.
Creation acquires helpers and masks in order and on any failure unwinds in reverse, freeing masks and helpers and dropping CPU protection before reporting null.
Scanning consumes leading space and each token in turn, ends cleanly at a bare terminator while preserving earlier error state, and otherwise records failures and continues with later tokens.
Early startup registers dynamic hotplug handling when supported and links per possible CPU descriptors into a global free pool, emitting only a warning when setup fails.
Generic object callbacks act as stable entry points that adapt kernel object operations into instance specific show and store behavior.

Drain on an offline queue warns and returns without waiting, a full color ring parks newcomers on overflow until space frees, and only the current leader performs cascade after a mutex protected recheck for races.
Verbose dumps execute with interrupts masked and therefore defer console output and refresh the watchdog to avoid false lockup reports during long atomic walks.
Mask replacement can fail during scratch allocation, text parsing, or application, always discarding the scratch state and returning the failure.
Argument handling detects when a parameter setter wrongly reenables interrupts and reports the offending option.
Device teardown clears the cached pointer before unregistering and tolerates absence, with an alternate build where teardown never acts.
Minus one marks no color for waiter request and for preparation inputs where a non negative choice selects a ring position.
Mask attributes are named serial_cpumask and parallel_cpumask, with helper macros assigning mode 0644 to writable entries and mode 0400 to read only entries.
Mask application selects between PADATA_CPU_SERIAL and PADATA_CPU_PARALLEL according to attribute name.
